title: Managing photos — uploading, order, cover image, moving cover image
body:
On the **„Fotók”** page you manage the images that appear on your site. At the start, your site works with the images it was given; the bar at the top of the page offers this: **„Ha szeretné, feltölthet saját képeket.”** As soon as you upload your first own photos, the site switches to them, and the bar turns green: **„A saját fotói láthatók az oldalán.”**

The line below the title always tells you how many images you have, and reminds you of the two rules: the first one is the cover image, and the order can be arranged by dragging.

![Screenshot: the Photos page on a phone](assets/hu/screen.png)

## Uploading your own photos

1. Open the **„Fotók”** page. Above the images there is a bar with a dashed border: **„Húzza ide a fotóit”** (if your site supports a moving cover image, the **„Moving cover image”** card sits above it). The same bar also lists the rules: JPEG, PNG or WEBP, at most 6 MB per image, at most 12 images at a time, and the library holds 24 images in total.
2. Tap the **„Fotók választása”** button — your phone offers your gallery, and you can select several images at once. On a phone, the **„Fényképezés”** button lets you take a photo right away. On a computer, you can also drag the images onto the bar (or anywhere on the page). At the top right of the page, the **„Feltöltés”** button opens the same picker.
3. In the bar, a row with a progress indicator appears for each image. If an image does not meet the rules (it is not an image, it is too large, or the library is full), its row turns red and tells you why — the other images are still uploaded. At the end the page refreshes, and your images appear in the grid.

Your first own upload **replaces** the images the site started with: you do not need to delete them.

## Grid or list

Above the images, the **„Rács”** / **„Lista”** switch lets you choose a view; your device remembers your choice.

- In the **grid**, every image is a tile with its number; the first tile carries the **„Nyitókép”** label. On a computer, when you hover the mouse over a tile, its actions appear: ★ (**„Legyen ez a nyitókép”**), ‹ (**„Előrébb”**), › (**„Hátrébb”**) and, for your own photos, the bin (**„Törlés”**). On a phone you find the same actions in the enlarged view or in the list view.
- In the **list**, every image is a row: on the left the handle (**„Húzza a rendezéshez”**) and the number, next to it the thumbnail, the caption field, the cover image button, a label showing whether it is your own image or a sample image, and the ‹ › buttons.

## Cover image and order

The **first image is the cover image** — it appears largest at the top of your site (the cover image indicator on the Overview shows the same). So it is worth putting your nicest, most characteristic image here.

- **„Legyen ez a nyitókép”** (★): moves the image to the first place. In the list, the **„Legyen nyitókép”** button does the same for images that are not first; the first one carries the **„Nyitókép”** label.
- **„Előrébb”** (‹) and **„Hátrébb”** (›): move the image one step.
- **Dragging:** on a computer, simply drag the tile or the row to the place you want.

The order is saved immediately, and your public site shows the images in the same order.

## Moving cover image

If your site has a look that supports it, the **„Moving cover image”** card appears above the images. On the left (on a phone, at the top) you see your cover image exactly as guests see it: when switched on, the image moves gently, with a sense of depth, as if the camera were slowly moving closer. We add nothing to the photo; only your own image moves.

1. Tap the switch. Its state is always shown next to it: **„On”** or **„Off”**.
2. The setting is saved immediately; there is no separate button. Below it you see: **„Saved. The cover image on your site now moves.”**, and when you switch it off: **„Saved. The cover image on your site is now a still image.”** If the movement of the cover image is still being prepared when you switch it on, you see: **„Saved. The cover image will start moving as soon as it is ready.”**
3. If saving fails (for example, your internet connection dropped), you see: **„Could not save. Please try again.”** — in that case, tap the switch again.

If you choose a **new cover image** or upload your own photo, we need to prepare the movement of the new image. This usually takes less than a minute; until then you see: **„New cover image: its depth effect is being prepared, usually ready within 1 minute. Until then a still image is shown.”** Your site also shows a still image until it is ready; after that it starts moving on its own (**„Done — the cover image is moving.”**).

If the cover image is too small, the card tells you: **„This cover image is too small for motion, so it stays still. It will move with a larger photo.”** For other reasons (for example, if the image comes from a map service) it says: **„Motion is not available for this cover image, so it stays still.”** — in that case, making one of your own photos the cover image will make it move.

Guests who have turned off motion on their phone (an accessibility setting) always see a still image on your site.

## Enlarged view

Tap any image: it opens full screen, with its number at the top („3 / 16”) and whether it is your own image or a sample image. Use the arrows (on a computer, the arrow keys as well) to browse; at the bottom you find the caption field, the **„Legyen ez a nyitókép”** button (on the first image: **„Ez a nyitókép”**) and, for your own photos, **„Törlés”**. Close it with the ✕ button at the top left or with the Esc key.

## Caption

In the list and in the enlarged view, every image has a field: **„Mi látszik a képen?”** — write a short sentence here and leave the field (or press Enter). The **„Mentve”** indicator briefly appears next to the row. This serves two purposes: for visually impaired guests, their phone reads it aloud, and Google also uses it to understand what is in the image — in other words, it helps people find your site.

## Deleting an image

You can remove your own photo with the bin in the tile's action bar, with the bin in the list row, or with the **„Törlés”** button in the enlarged view; before every deletion we ask for confirmation (**„Fotó törlése”**), which you can cancel with **„Mégsem”**.

Several images at once: the **„Kijelölés”** button above the images switches to selection mode; tap the images you want to delete, then the **„Törlés”** button in the bar that appears at the bottom of the page (the bar counts how many images are selected; **„Mégse”** leaves selection mode). Deletion is permanent.

Sample images have no delete button: they disappear on their own as soon as you use your own photos.

## Which room does the image belong to?

If you have several rooms or apartments to let, the **„Melyik szobához?”** question appears in every row of the list view and in the enlarged view, with the names of your rooms. Tick where the image belongs and tap the **„Mentés”** button. An image can belong to several rooms; whatever you do not assign anywhere stays in the shared gallery of the house. This way it is enough to upload each image once — the room subpages will show the images assigned to them.
